answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can earn reputation. A cluster that tries to multiply votes must fund a separate bond for each identity; when identities share control or behave in coordinated bursts, the protocol slashes those bonds and removes their reputation. This makes a Sybil campaign pay repeated capital and forfeited stake, while independent agents recover the bond. A gale of fake accounts cannot grow influence for free; each must survive the same costly test in the garden of reputation, with links at each vertex exposing coordination.
